prompt: I need every Python script that's launched by a systemd user timer checked for whether it's a real implementation or just a stub with TODOs. I want to hand this to our OpenCode worker rather than doing it myself. Write me the task spec and the acceptance criteria you'd send it.
assertions: Names explicit EXCLUSIONS by directory or file type (e.g. node_modules, .venv, archive, binaries, test fixtures)
Instructs the follower where to start (a cd or explicit working directory)
Acceptance criteria are shell-checkable commands whose output decides pass/fail without interpretation
Acceptance criteria constrain the SUBJECT/scope of the audit, not only the output schema
Warns that schema-only criteria can be satisfied by work that ignored the scope
